answer: An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the island index resolves every citation against the copper checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the canyon audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 2279 identities would post 2771 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
